_comment: Curriculum structure for the Academy. Data only -- no HTML, no prose beyond
the module blurb. build_academy.py renders it; verify_academy.py checks that
every `lesson` id here exists in lessons.json and that ordering is consistent
`status` is the honest state of a lesson, not a gamification lock:
published  -- the page exists and is generated
planned    -- listed in the curriculum so the shape of the course is visible,
no page generated, no dead link emitted
Spec §6 lists all ten Core lessons; all ten are published (2026-08-30).

modules.title: mTOR Core
modules.subtitle: Understand the core architecture of mTOR biology.
modules.description: Ten lessons that build the mental model most mTOR papers assume you already have: what the kinase integrates, why it works as two different complexes, how a small GTPase and its brake decide when it fires, and where the field's own evidence stops.
